title: Reel kit
summary: The user's light "reel kit" cards as on-screen UI for talking-head footage: the theme backdrop, a platform orbit, a strike-through checklist and a scrolling screen. (The chat composer, storyboard pages, "Editing with…" card, RAW / EDITED split and comment-for-all end card are now full Effects: ai_prompt, storyboard_pages, edit_preview, raw_vs_edit, catalog_grid; the old overlay versions are retired, kept only for older projects.) One brand look set by props (accent #2F5BEA, highlight #FFE03C, ink, paper, background grid|solid). Any footage storyboard borrows a piece with "theme": "ui/reel-kit".
